mapper.sql: t.id, t.session_id, t.sitting_no, t.section_no, t.section_name, t.section_type, t.question_count, t.max_score, t.objective_score, t.duration_min, t.duration_max, t.allow_early_submit, t.support_status, t.used_sec, t.status, t.started_at, t.finished_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exam_session_section (session_id, sitting_no, section_no, section_name, section_type, question_count, max_score, objective_score, duration_min, duration_max, allow_early_submit, support_status, used_sec, status, started_at, finished_at) VALUES
(#{r.sessionId}, #{r.sittingNo}, #{r.sectionNo}, #{r.sectionName}, #{r.sectionType}, #{r.questionCount}, #{r.maxScore}, #{r.objectiveScore}, #{r.durationMin}, #{r.durationMax}, #{r.allowEarlySubmit}, #{r.supportStatus}, #{r.usedSec}, #{r.status}, #{r.startedAt}, #{r.finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_session_section t WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY t.section_no
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_session_section SET status = 'FINISHED', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, used_sec = IF(started_at IS NULL, used_sec, GREATEST(used_sec, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, started_at, #{finishedAt}))) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND sitting_no = #{sittingNo} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
